# VOXFIRE.io

> VOXFIRE.io is a fast-paced, free-to-play 3D blocky multiplayer browser first-person shooter (FPS) built with Three.js and WebRTC. Play instantly in any web browser with no download or sign-up required.

## Quick Facts
- **Website**: https://parshvashah2008.github.io/voxfire-io/
- **Genre**: 3D Browser FPS, Blocky Multiplayer Shooter, Action Game, IO Game
- **Platforms**: Web Browser (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge) on PC, Mac, Android, and iOS
- **Player Modes**: Single-player vs Bots, 2-Player Private Rooms, 4v4 Multiplayer, Up to 8 Players
- **Pricing**: Free-to-play (100% Free, No download)

## Game Modes
- **Global Players**: Drop-in public multiplayer matchmaking (GTA Online style) with real players worldwide.
- **Private Room**: Create or join custom private rooms with a 6-character room code to play with friends (2-player, 4-player, 8-player matches).
- **4v4 Terrorist vs Anti-Terrorist (T vs AT)**: Tactical team combat where players choose their faction during pre-game cooldown.
- **Team Deathmatch (TDM)**: Fast-paced team battle.
- **Free For All (FFA)**: Classic all-vs-all deathmatch.
- **Gun Game**: Advance through 20 different weapon tiers with each elimination.
- **Offline / Practice**: Solo play against AI bots with adjustable difficulty.

## Key Features
- Over 20 voxel weapons (Assault Rifles, Sniper Rifles, Shotguns, SMGs, Pistols).
- Smooth 60Hz - 120Hz performance.
- Mobile and tablet support with custom virtual joystick and Kour.io-style precision auto-fire.
- Player progression: XP leveling, custom tags, and weapon loadouts.
